description: An invariant certificate checked, and consecution as a query whose counterexample the kernel checks.

result.text:
; Consecution: sat exactly where the invariant holds of a state and fails after one step.
; A model is a counterexample to induction for the kernel to check; unsat is not a verdict.
(set-option :produce-models true)
(set-logic ALL)

; Records and variants.
; {n: Int}
(declare-datatype |record:d1a0623e| ((|record:d1a0623e| (|record:d1a0623e.n| Int))))
; A variant with the cases cancelled, child, world.
(declare-datatype |variant:57725bf5| ((|variant:57725bf5#cancelled|) (|variant:57725bf5#child| (|variant:57725bf5#child.error| String)) (|variant:57725bf5#world| (|variant:57725bf5#world.detail| String))))
; A variant with the cases count.
(declare-datatype |variant:e84bfc6b| ((|variant:e84bfc6b#count| (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.call| Int) (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.value| Int))))
; {}
(declare-datatype |record:49d8b93e| ((|record:49d8b93e|)))
; A variant with the cases failed, refused, ret, start.
(declare-datatype |variant:11944920| ((|variant:11944920#failed| (|variant:11944920#failed.call| Int) (|variant:11944920#failed.error| |variant:57725bf5|) (|variant:11944920#failed.op| String)) (|variant:11944920#refused| (|variant:11944920#refused.call| Int) (|variant:11944920#refused.op| String)) (|variant:11944920#ret| (|variant:11944920#ret.| |variant:e84bfc6b|)) (|variant:11944920#start| (|variant:11944920#start.value| |record:49d8b93e|))))
; {call: Int, value: Int}
(declare-datatype |record:1fc44c8e| ((|record:1fc44c8e| (|record:1fc44c8e.call| Int) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| Int))))

; Definitions.
; The invariant, of a state.
(define-fun |def:invariant| ((|v:state| |record:d1a0623e|)) Bool (>= (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) 0))
; The state the step gives.
(define-fun |def:next| ((|v:state| |record:d1a0623e|) (|v:input| |variant:11944920|)) |record:d1a0623e| (let ((|c:1| |v:input|)) (ite ((_ is |variant:11944920#failed|) |c:1|) |v:state| (ite ((_ is |variant:11944920#refused|) |c:1|) |v:state| (ite ((_ is |variant:11944920#ret|) |c:1|) (let ((|v:r| (|variant:11944920#ret.| |c:1|))) (let ((|c:2| |v:r|)) (let ((|v:c| (|record:1fc44c8e| (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.call| |c:2|) (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.value| |c:2|)))) (|record:d1a0623e| (+ (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| |v:c|)))))) |v:state|)))))
; Where the kernel evaluates next without an error; elsewhere the function above is unconstrained.
(define-fun |defined:next| ((|v:state| |record:d1a0623e|) (|v:input| |variant:11944920|)) Bool (let ((|c:1| |v:input|)) (let ((|v:r| (|variant:11944920#ret.| |c:1|))) (let ((|c:2| |v:r|)) (let ((|v:c| (|record:1fc44c8e| (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.call| |c:2|) (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.value| |c:2|)))) (=> (and ((_ is |variant:11944920#ret|) |c:1|) ((_ is |variant:e84bfc6b#count|) |c:2|)) (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) (+ (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| |v:c|))) (<= (+ (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| |v:c|)) 9007199254740991))))))))

; A counterexample to induction.
(declare-const |q:state| |record:d1a0623e|)
(declare-const |q:input| |variant:11944920|)
(assert (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) (|record:d1a0623e.n| |q:state|)) (<= (|record:d1a0623e.n| |q:state|) 9007199254740991)))
(assert (and (=> ((_ is |variant:11944920#failed|) |q:input|) (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) (|variant:11944920#failed.call| |q:input|)) (<= (|variant:11944920#failed.call| |q:input|) 9007199254740991))) (=> ((_ is |variant:11944920#refused|) |q:input|) (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) (|variant:11944920#refused.call| |q:input|)) (<= (|variant:11944920#refused.call| |q:input|) 9007199254740991))) (=> ((_ is |variant:11944920#ret|) |q:input|) (=> ((_ is |variant:e84bfc6b#count|) (|variant:11944920#ret.| |q:input|)) (and (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.call| (|variant:11944920#ret.| |q:input|))) (<= (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.call| (|variant:11944920#ret.| |q:input|)) 9007199254740991)) (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.value| (|variant:11944920#ret.| |q:input|))) (<= (|variant:e84bfc6b#count.value| (|variant:11944920#ret.| |q:input|)) 9007199254740991)))))))
(assert (|def:invariant| |q:state|))
(assert (|defined:next| |q:state| |q:input|))
(assert (not (|def:invariant| (|def:next| |q:state| |q:input|))))
(check-sat)
(get-value (|q:state| |q:input|))
